title: Factory-built housing rules for Lahaina rebuild
summary: On February 6, 2026, the council took up Bill 15, which sets rules for factory-built housing in the Lahaina burn zone, and amended it. One amendment requires approved factories to be in Hawaiʻi, and another uses county inspectors instead of third-party inspectors. The sponsor said survivors might have to order up to 200 of the same home from an off-island factory, and a testifier said some families won't rebuild unless costs drop and timelines speed up.
